note: Whiteboard tutorial (owner decisions 2026-11-14), read by TutorialSystem (host) and shown by TutorialPresenter, TutorialHud, StoryLogPanel and the HUD goal card (state.campaign.objectives). It replaces the Prompt Pack's old ten-stage tutorial. Three steps: arrival, the first team's six tapes (Prompt Pack C01/C02), then fixing the base's broken spots (T01-T12 without T05 and T07). Every objective is checked on the host from the real colony state: tapes collected (state.repair.collected_cassettes), tapes played (host-accepted cassette_select / cassette_read at the Command Room player) and spots fixed (state.repair.tasks[id].first_completed). Mission Control is the guide: its lines are in 'messages' and are sent once each as system alerts. 'text_team' replaces 'text' with four players, where switching crew is disabled. Counts (6 tapes, 10 spots) are game design, not NASA numbers.
speaker: Mission Control

messages.welcome: Welcome to Mars, crew. It is the 2060s and Earth is in trouble: people need a new home. You are the second team sent here. The first team could not finish their mission.
messages.radio_down: Your crew radio is broken, so for now only Mission Control can talk to you. We opened every door for you. Walk into the base and look for the gold lines on the floor.
messages.tapes_start: The first team left a tape in each of the 6 main rooms. Find all 6 tapes by following the gold lines. Each pickup unlocks that room's repairs immediately. You can play any tape you have found at the Command Room cassette player; playing your first tape unlocks the other station features.
messages.tapes_all_found: All 6 tapes found! Every room's repairs are unlocked. Keep playing the tapes at the Command Room cassette player: they tell us what happened.
messages.fix_start: Fix the base: get it to operational condition. The tapes showed us 10 broken spots. Some jobs need a specialist: the list shows who.
messages.radio_back: We can hear the whole crew again: your crew radio works. Hold V to talk.
messages.base_operational: The base is operational! Great work, crew. The doors work normally again and every machine is yours to use.

stages.title: Arrival
stages.intro: You stand outside the first team's base in your suits. The doors are open.

objectives.text: Walk into the base through the open doors.
objectives.explain: W A S D to walk, the mouse to look. Your suit keeps you safe outside. Inside the base you can breathe the air.
hints: Walk forward: the open doors are right in front of you.
Press J to see your goals on a map of the base.

stages.title: The first team's tapes
stages.intro: Each main room has one tape from the first team.

objectives.text: Find the 6 room tapes: one in each main room.
objectives.explain: Follow a gold line to a glowing tape, look at it and press E. There is one in each main room, including inside the Garden dome. The crew shares the tapes. Each pickup unlocks that room's minigames: green means anyone can do it, gold means your specialty, and red means another specialist is needed. Keep finding all 6 tapes.
hints: Press J to see the tapes on a map of the base.
Look at a tape and press E.

objectives.text: Play every tape on the cassette player in the Command Room.
objectives.explain: Return to the Command Room cassette player whenever you find a tape: you can play it immediately without finding the other tapes first. Each shows a photo and explains its room. Playing your first tape unlocks the other station features. Keep collecting and playing all 6.
hints: The cassette player is in the Command Room. Look at it and press E.
Choose a tape in the list to play it.

stages.title: Fix the base
stages.intro: Fix the base: get it to operational condition.

objectives.text: Fix the base: fix every broken spot on the list.
objectives.explain: Look at a broken spot and press E to start fixing it. A job with a specialist symbol can only be done by that specialist. A room is restored when all its broken spots are fixed.
hints: Look at a broken spot and press E.
A ⚡, ✚ or ⛏ job needs that specialist. Press C in the Med Bay to swap to them.
hints_team: Look at a broken spot and press E.
A ⚡, ✚ or ⛏ job needs that specialist. Ask the player of that crew member.

certification.words: Next goal after the base works: all five sectors and communications work, and the battery, water, oxygen and food stay above zero for one full sol with no emergency rescue.

campaign_tips.energy: ⚡ Energy: clean a dusty panel or repair the cleaner, then answer why dusty panels give less power.
campaign_tips.life_support: ✚ Life support: run both oxygen makers for an hour each, then answer which one needs water.
campaign_tips.food: ❀ Food: inspect a plant that shows a symptom (yellow, wilting or pale), then answer the symptom question.
campaign_tips.resources: ⚙ Resources: inspect a salvage donor and choose the part that fits, then answer the salvage question.
campaign_tips.science: ✦ Science: the ⛏ Field engineer takes a field sample at a sample site, then answer the 'where and when' question.
campaign_tips.comms: ✉ Communications: install the first radio repair card at the comms console.
campaign_tips.food_stock: Four crew eat 12 meals per sol. Plant more beds so the food store does not run out.
